title: CaptureChunkRequest
description: Declaration of one capture chunk. (session_id, seq) is the idempotency key: resending it with the same bytes is safe and replays the acknowledgement. Intervals are on the capture timebase and must be contiguous with the client's chunking: chunk n covers [n * chunk_duration_ms, (n + 1) * chunk_duration_ms) except the last. Requests are validated strictly; an unknown field or timebase is a validation error.

seq.description: Zero-based position of the chunk in the session. Not reused within a session.

interval.description: Capture-relative interval this chunk covers; timebase must be capture.
